description: This is a test class for the ReferencePlaceholder functionality within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.concierge.enforcement.placeholders.references package. It contains unit tests validating the parsing logic of reference placeholders from string representations, ensuring correct extraction of referenced entity IDs, fields, and entity types, as well as handling invalid inputs and exceptions.

classes.name: ReferencePlaceholderTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ReferencePlaceholder functionality, testing parsing and validation of reference placeholders from string inputs.

methods.name: fromCharSequence
methods.description: Tests the extraction of ReferencePlaceholder from valid string representations, ensuring correct parsing of entity IDs, fields, and entity types.

methods.name: fromCharSequenceWithSpacesAfterBraces
methods.description: Verifies that placeholders with spaces after braces are correctly parsed.

methods.name: fromCharSequenceWithInvalidPlaceholderIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks that invalid placeholder strings result in empty Optionals, indicating failed parsing.

methods.name: fromCharSequenceWithDeepPointer
methods.description: Validates parsing of placeholders referencing deep/nested JSON fields.

methods.name: fromCharSequenceWithUnsupportedEntityTypeThrowsException
methods.description: Ensures that placeholders referencing unsupported entity types throw the appropriate exception.
